468596.overview: A mind-bending game of falling rings.

468597.overview: Get behind the wheel of some of the fastest concept cars, racing on closed roads around the world. Featuring 12 customizable cars across 3 performance categories, 8 reversible tracks, 2 championship modes, challenging computer opponents, 2-player splitscreen mode, trophies and global (P2P) high scores.

468598.overview:
Comet! It's a classic arcade game and a modern puzzler - in the back seat at a drive in B-movie. A deceptively simple game of flying saucers, space mines, alien worlds and, of course, comets!

Comet! features high-speed action gameplay, unique but intuitive controls, extensive stat tracking, classic sci-fi flair, millions of points and lots of explosions.

468599.overview:
Compromised is a twin stick/bullet hell/shmup hybrid best described as a mix between Insanely Twisted Shadow Planet and Geometry Wars, inspired by our childhoods playing NES, SNES and Sega games.

Explore the world of Se-Da and struggle to return home after being cut off and isolated from everything during the BIOC invasion.

Fend off 25+ enemies with various attacks and strategies using your standard machine gun, missiles and bombs, plus 4 special attacks used by spending collected energy.

Battle ridiculously large and awesome bosses, each boss battle is their own insane level.

468600.overview:
Design, build and ride your very own roller coasters. Choose between a wide variety of different carriages & environments and also paint the track as you like. Once you are happy with your roller coaster you can then share it with the world over Xbox Live. Roller coasters others have shared will also be available for you to download, ride and rate.

Start constructing today!

468601.overview:
“Comet Turn” is a game that can score when a comet completes “techniques” like that it goes around a planet or it confines all the planets in orbit. You can find the techniques in the "technique list". And there are also hidden techniques that are related to the constellation.

The rule has ”Gain” that only gets the score and “Arrest and Escape” that takes it when the planet captures the comet.

468602.overview: Constrictor is a Snake variant. The player controls a snake which grows larger after eating yellow dots. The game is over when crashing into obstacles (such as obstacles, the own tail or other players) and the goal is to accumulate points by surviving long enough. While the single-player is basic, there are also three multiplayer modes: predator (trying to eat them), wraith (running away from them) or sport (playing ball). There a few additional options which change the game, e.g. power-ups for gaining special abilities.

468603.overview: A 3D action-strategy game in which the player is to maintain the stability of planet SL-49 by raising and herding a breed of bugs whose spores are capable of powering machines that keep their universe in equilibrium.

468604.overview:
Contract: Void Justice is a sci-fi third-person shooter which can be played in single and multiplayer (2 player co-op) modes. Players take on the role of a mercenary who has just delivered a prisoner to the space prison ship PPG-871. When prisoners escape during a blackout and begin rioting, the mercenary is hired by the warden to kill the rioters.

The objective is to kill all the enemies on a given level, and players are equipped with both a gun and a sword for this purpose. Money collected by killing enemies can be spent on items at a shop such as a compass and a level map.

468606.overview: This is a game in 3D. Where strange creatures want to eliminate the whole humanity. You must defend at any expense. Good luck...

468607.overview: Build something abstract, build something cute or build something awesome - whatever your mood is. This game offers a truly open-ended experience where the limits are only your imagination and ..360 building blocks. The game also comes with a challenge mode, 3 levels of difficulty and in-game awards. Train your perception and memory building against time randomly generated 3D structures.

468608.overview:
Controdazone! It’s "Control" + "The" + "Zone", get it?

This game is a twin stick shooter with a twist. Instead of killing your opponents you fight vigorously for control over the “zone”, a circular area that travels around the screen. Battle with up to 4 friends, or hone your skills against the bots. Grab power ups to give you an edge in battle.

468609.overview: The XBOX Avatars need to get places and you are the only one Dr. Jacque will trust with his ship. Test your flying skills in a series of mind bending gravity scenarios. Venture deep into the core of planets and dodge asteroids as you deliver avatars to their destinations. If you're really good you just might be the first person to beat the last level. We never have.

468610.overview: Shapes drop down and dart across the gridded aisles, connecting through electric impulses with the solitary goal of expending their energy as the breaking integer is reached while tech-inspired beats caress the aural waves until complete vicissitude. Can you get SSS in each one of this challenging, quick-paced puzzle game's 10 zones?

468611.overview:
You are the cootie crusher! People come to you to resolve their cootie infestations.

Crush those little bugs as quickly as you can. You get bonuses for speed and accuracy.

468612.overview: Cops and Robbers is a throw back to the classic arcade style that we all love. Get all the coins without getting busted by the cops!

468613.overview: Ever wish you could check to see if your controller is working properly? Now you can with Controller Doctor! Perform over 10 tests that examine your controller's buttons, thumb sticks and triggers!

468615.overview:
A collection of 5 arcade style mini-games that will keep you and your friends hooked and entertained for hours on end!

Include High Hopes (winner of the 2009 48 Hour Game Making Challenge in Brisbane, Australia), Jurassic Bar, Cave In, Triangle Man and Bop!

Fun for the whole family!

468618.overview:
Corsair is a fixed-screen shooter in which the player either takes the role of the defending Camariam Consortium or the attacking Valaxus Empire. The Camarians use small and fast fighters called Corsair which use the classic Asteroids controls: The ship keeps its momentum and the player can use thrust to accelerate into the ships current alignment which can be changed by rotating the ship. It also governs the direction of the shots. However, in contrast to Asteroids, the ship can also brake and strafe. The Valaxus Empire uses Decimators instead. These ships are almost as big as the screen and therefore has very restricted movement. It is also equipped with four turrets which can be individually rotated and fired.

Whichever mode is chosen, the goal is always to kill the opposing forces within a time limit to earn a high score. The fight is always one Decimator against four Corsair.

468619.overview:
Due to light pollution the stars in the sky are now barely visible near major cities. It is your job to fix this problem and brighten the stars!

Using gravity to sling-shot yourself around levels you must brighten the cosmos so everyone can enjoy a bright starry night in all its splendour.

468621.overview: Measure the speed of your USB storage devices, hard drives, and memory units, and view other information about your console and controllers.

468623.overview:
Race against the clock or your friend to get the highest score you can.

How well do you know your controller?

468624.overview: Cool Shapes is a new puzzle game where you have to fill in the hi-lighted area on the grid. But the Shapes can't pass through each other. So you may need to navigate around to get the pices where you need them.

468626.overview: Help Coral in her quest to break the spell that has transformed her into a frightening new form. Use your tail to slither to high ledges and solve unique puzzles. Cast spells like fireball and frostbolt, or use your tail to defeat various enemies. Collect resources to improve your abilities and become even more powerful. Coral's Curse is a platformer unlike anything you've seen before!

468627.overview:
A unique 3D platformer that starts out easy enough but soon supplies tension in gargantuan degrees!

Wrestle with 50 challenging levels as new elements appear and old ones change. Take to multiplayer to experience something new where every one of 20 levels fundamentally changes play.

Though your ultimate aim is to come out on top, sometimes survival takes a higher priority.

468628.overview: Hack and slash your way through hoards of enemies, with up to 3 other players. Upgrade your character's skills while working to accomplish a sinister goal. Featuring a unique dual-stick control scheme, for both melee and ranged combat. Corrupteds campaign and arena modes provide hours of fun!

468629.overview: Stuntman Joe is lost in space. Will he find a way out?

468630.overview:
Survive the ever growing waves of Alien space ships in this arcade style shooter!

With five different gameplay modes including an epic boss battle against the mothership, set yourself the highest score and survive for as long as you can!

468635.overview: One part crafting game and one part 2D platformer, Craftimals lets you build your own way to the top! Play single-player or local co-op and help the animals reach the sun. Checkpoints along the way give you new powers and hats. Find out what happens when you touch the sun, or simply have fun building!

468636.overview: Push your reflexes to the limits with this challenging game of endurance and skill. Featuring four progressive modes of stylish bovine action, defend the Earth against otherworldly invasion by intercepting genetically modified cattle being launched at rural communities. Save the world from destruction with the aid of your trusty wagon and become a legendary folk hero!

468638.overview:
Crawlers and Brawlers is a RPG descended from the 8bit classics. It has you choose between three different classes to become an adventurer and go on a fantastic journey through many epic procedurally generated dungeons. Collect powerful loot on your way to develop your character with nothing to stand in your way of being exactly what you were meant to be, AWESOME. Join your friends in local or online co-op crawls through the dungeons then brawl online on 12 different multiplayer maps after you're so powerful no dungeon can contain you.

Three different classes; warrior, mage and cleric.
Collect loot to make your character more powerful.
Hundreds of procedurally generated dungeons.
An engaging single player campaign.
Online multiplayer with up to 16 players on 12 multiplayer maps.
Two, three, and four player local split-screen co-op.

468639.overview:
Couples Sudoku is a variant of the number puzzle Sudoku. The definition of this traditional pen & paper puzzle can be found in the associated game group.

The specialty of this version are the two-player modes. Players can either compete against each other or work together by solving the same puzzle. Single players have the choice between four game modes (standard, timed, first to number and arcade) and multiple difficulty levels. The puzzles are randomly generated.

468640.overview: This twin-stick shooter mixed with a turn-based card game offers loads of fun! Through three unique game modes, experience the wild west with explosions, teepees, cowboys hats and robots! Play with a friend in multiplayer mode.

468641.overview:
Crazy Balloon Lite is a fun game of navigation and nerves.

The Land of the Balloons has been invaded by nasty spikes. You need to navigate this overrun terrain to make it back to your balloon friends!

468643.overview: Whoa - an ATM that spits out money, all you need to do is move your remote controlled piggy banks to catch it as it falls from the sky. One or Two Players.

468646.overview: Crazy Ball is a wild and fast-paced soccer game, designed with multiplayer action in mind. This is a game that will captivate you as soon as you feel the satisfaction of scoring your first goal and rubbing it in your opponent's face. That is until they become a giant, swat you away like a fly, turn the ball in a tiny bullet and smash it into your goal. The rules are set, the battle can begin.

468650.overview: Artificial Intelligence has gone too far. Only you can prevent a Nuclear Crisis.

468651.overview:
Croc´s World is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

Jump and run through the levels and dodge all enemies.

Collect a helmet to crush stoneblocks. Collect the stonebag to throw stones.

If you collect 100 diamonds you´ll get an extra life!

468652.overview:
Play with CRAZY particles! Activate special effects to make the CRAZY particles even more CRAZY!

Change the CRAZY Color, Speed, Size, Angle and Gravity direction.

468653.overview:
Croc's World 3 is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

Jump and run through the levels and dodge all enemies. Collect a helmet to crush stoneblocks. Collect special items like 'Firehelmet' (walk through fire) or 'Shield' (Invincible for 10 seconds)!

If you collect 100 diamonds you´ll get an extra life!

468656.overview: Puzzle running game. Find the end portal beat the game. Contains JRPG train your critter to defend you from wild attacks. can you train you critter to Level 99?

468657.overview: The Extreme! edition of the popular Kart-racing title brings an all-new UI and tons of multiplayer fun. Capture-the-Flag, Tag, and vs racing across Xbox LIVE, System Link, or even split screen! Includes 8 all-new multiplayer battle arenas. All for a special introductory price of just 80 points!

468658.overview: 3D Survival - They say I's crazy, but this shotgun ain't crazy! There's demons everywhere, and I know what to do to demons. Point my boom stick at em and exorcise their face off! -- Kill waves of demons using a variety of weapons and abilities in this 3D overhead action game.

468659.overview: In Crazy Ride with Zombies, players are tasked with trying to survive a thrill ride on a dangerous rollercoaster that is set on the side of snow covered mountain. The game is all about having good timing. Players have to punch hanging zombies and falling rocks at the right time to remove them from the tracks or else the player will crash into them. Players also have to jump tree branches being wielded by zombies.

468660.overview:
Help Crazy Wizard defeat the evil that lurks in Creepy Castle!

In this fun platformer you fight monsters, ghosts and dragons!

468662.overview:
Creed Arena is a third person shooter where the player takes the role of a contestant in a futuristic gladiator game. There are two perspectives that the player can switch between at any time: behind and bird's eye view. The goal is to become the most famous gladiator of all time and to accomplish that the player has to enter the arena and compete in a tournament consisting of several challenges. The success of the player is measured by how many fans he manages to win over to his side. To gets the player has to impress the stadium crowd by killing enemies and completing challenges. Quick successive kills and melee kills are some ways to really increase the fame of the player while dying will cost some fans. The player has a crowd rage meter that goes up as the crowd gets impressed. When full the player becomes faster, tougher and can do extra damage.

There are four different game modes that the player will come across in the tournament. In the survival mode the player and a team mate has to survive an onslaught of monsters, wave after wave without losing all lives. The deathmatch mode is everyone against everyone and the winner is the one that first reaches a target number of kills. It also exist in a team variant. Collect the Kegs is the game's variant of capture the flag. The player has to retrieve kegs from the enemy and bring them back to the base. In the popularity mode the player competes against a team mate and has to kill waves of enemies. The one that reaches a popularity target first wins.

The Xbox 360 version features multiplayer. It allows two players to play through the tournament in co-op, both online and offline. While online up to eight players can compete.

468663.overview: Gangs are fighting for the control of Norpen City. As Special Agent John Adams, you are sent to bring back order in the city. Criminals Under Arrest is a story driven beat'em up, where you have the possibilty to start from any level. Wanna start with the last boss? That's up to you.

468665.overview: The Government and Oil Corporations have failed to stop the oil leak. Clearly they haven't tried TOWER DEFENSE!! Do you have what it takes to cap the leak?

468667.overview: It's the year 2012, take to the skies in an effort to liberate the North Korean people from their ruthless dictator. Fight planes, ships, and subs in this exciting arcade style shooter.

468668.overview: "Croc's World 2" is a really nice jump'n'run with 60 incredible levels and many challenging enemies!

468673.overview: Crimson Blues is an action puzzle-platform where the player is able to shift between red and blue modes, gaining new abilities when interacting with different colored objects. The game features a full tutorial mode leading up to the single player game, as well as a 2 player gameplay with unlockable extras and new modes.

468676.overview:
Crystal Crush is a tile matching puzzle. In the middle of the screen is an arrangement of hex tiles which can be rotated by the player. On the sides are entry points for colored crystals; in all modes but repulse the launch is manually triggered.

The specific goal depends on the playing mode: match three (creating same colored groups of three or more to remove them from the playfield), colour match (there are three big arrangements which need to be filled with correctly colored crystals), repulse (only one color is allowed to be placed; the others need to be deflected by touching them with a placed crystal) and join (the player needs to connect gold crystals by placing silver crystals).

Besides the standard crystals, there are also four special crystals: star (rewards bonus points), diamond (appears after a high combo and destroys all nearby crystals), virus (appears after four consecutive combos and destroys all connected crystals) and skull (game over when placed).

468682.overview:
Crystaloid is a breakout game. Clone of the famous Arkanoid.

Features:

-Over 40 Levels
-18 Power bonus
-Continue support

468686.overview:
Crypt of the Serpent King is a medieval first-person hack'n'slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements.

Explore large, randomly generated dungeons.
Fight goblins, orcs, skeletons, giant spiders and all sorts of underworld creatures.
Wield an array of melee and ranged weapons.
Jump over lava pits and spike traps.
Level up your character's abilities.
Choose between 3 levels of difficulty, from casual to hardcore.

468687.overview: Crosstown is a retro-style, top-down action game. Up to four players navigate a randomly-generated maze, collecting "qreds", avoiding and fighting various monsters, and drilling through walls. Once a player collects four qreds, play advances to the next level. Between levels, a computer named "PIGGY" tells the players about the rules of the game, the history of Crosstown and the monsters therein, and the strange nature of the reality where the game takes place.

468688.overview:
Crystal Hunters is a top down puzzle game featuring two playable characters, Thomas and Amelia. The game features an optional tutorial level, consisting of 5 levels, in which Grampa Buckley guides the player on game mechanics and offers tips for good crystal hunting. There are four worlds to journey through: the caves, the forest, the castle and the crystal caves. The goal of each level is the collect all the crystals on the map, which unlocks the door out. Thomas or Amelia must solve puzzles to reach the crystals, however, by pushing boxes to block enemies or adjust lasers to trigger switches. Challenges are added as the levels progress, such as new enemies and advanced ways to manipulate lasers, like mirrors.

There's also an art gallery, time challenges and achievements. The art gallery includes menu art and sketches which are viewable after finishing levels or meeting time challenges.

468689.overview: Avoid obstacles, and Aim the goal! It takes only two minutes, and no restriction code, so you can play well in the trial.

468690.overview: Take on hordes of grannies in HD and make their dentures fly, you get an arsenal of weapons at your disposal: gravity gun, grenades, crazy madness and MEGA BLASTER. Make the grannies fly into the granny grinder when they attack in buses, rascals they even got cannons and kamikaze-allies. You can actually combo the grandmothers into the grinder for more points and awesomeness.

468693.overview: Bubbles was quite the loveable pet fish, offering his owners endless hours of entertainment. Unfortunately, even good fish don't last forever, and like so many of his scaly brethren he was found floating at the top of his bowl, fins up. Having been unceremoniously flushed down the john, he now finds himself lost in the swirling vortex of the great beyond. (20 levels with “save anywhere” support)

468694.overview:
Classic Twin-Stick Shooter. Single and Online Multiplayer Battles in a retro style.

The Earth is under attack from an invisible enemy. In a microscopic world beneath the nature we can perceive, a battle rages for supremacy.

If you can handle the pressure then you must join the fight.

468699.overview: Rotate sections of a cube to make each side a single color in the fastest time possible.

468700.overview:
Cuadro is an action game centered around the gradual unveiling of hidden historical paintings. Each level begins with a concealed artwork, and the player's objective is to reveal it by navigating a ship across the canvas. As the ship moves, it uncovers the painting beneath. Players can also fire colored balls that bounce off walls and reveal additional areas.

A key mechanic involves balls of the same color colliding with each other. When this occurs, a larger portion of the painting is revealed, and the ship’s speed increases. While there are no traditional enemies, black balls pose a threat: they erase previously revealed sections and reduce the ship’s speed when struck by other balls. Occasionally, yellow balls appear, triggering temporary special effects upon impact for a few seconds.

Once the entire painting is revealed, the player receives a score based on their speed, the number of balls fired, and their accuracy. This score determines the type of key awarded - bronze, silver, or gold - which can be used to unlock new paintings, game modes, and bonus content within the museum. Achieving high scores also reveals the title and description of the painting, which becomes accessible in the museum. The museum serves as a hub for progression and exploration and is presented in a first-person perspective.

468703.overview:
Cutouts! A game made entirely from felt!

Run, duck, jump, and throw objects at your enemies! Collect buttons for extra lives!

Nine levels across three worlds!

468704.overview: Experience the story of a thief who can transform into her own shadow. In this 2-D side scroller, alternate between normal and shadow mode to navigate platforms and solve puzzles. Walk on the shadows of objects to get to new areas, move objects and light sources in order to change the shadow environment. Beware shadow monsters who stalk you and seek to destroy you.

468705.overview: A king sets out to rid his kingdom of a horrible curse.

468706.overview: Your egg-laying skills will be tested as you fly your Cuckoo bird through the forest. Will you go for the lower, more valuable nests but risk your bird by crashing into trees? Will you play it safe and risk running out of time? Complete all five challenges and claim your awards! We warn you: this game is addictive and fun for the whole family!

468707.overview:
Cubism takes the puzzle genre to a new dimension. Solve exciting and fun cube puzzles in an easy, yet challenging, intuitive way. Drag pieces onto a cube shape to solve the three dimensional puzzle.

Choose between three playing modes, including more than 50 levels, a puzzle and a free form mode. Choose piece type, cube shape and texture to play your unique puzzle.

468709.overview: Face off against the computer or three other friends and their avatars in the ultimate sprint. From the 100m dash to a 1500m endurance race, all mixed in with optional hurdles, only one can come away with the gold!

468710.overview: Cubix Cube is a digital adaption of the toy Rubic Cube. It consists of a cube with six faces, each made up of nine smaller squares in one of six solid colors. The puzzle's internal mechanism allows each face to rotate independently, scrambling the colors. The challenge is to return the cube to its original state, where each face displays a single uniform color. This version presents the puzzle in 3D and also includes a flat pattern view.

468715.overview:
Tired of zombies? Try cyberpunk instead.

Enter a world run by corporations that hire cyberrunners known as Deckers to hack systems. The matrix, however, is filled with intrusion countermeasures (ICE) that can kill if you aren't careful.

468716.overview: A new take on the classic game Snake. The CyberSnake is a prototype circuit build and repair program being put to the test in a crisis which could wipe out everyone within proximity.

468719.overview: Need a challenging alternative to the current wave of puzzle games? Look no further Cylinder is here! Cylinder is a puzzle game that will bend minds of players as it features an original 3D puzzle interface that tasks you with piece placement not only side to side, but across to the other side of your cylinder. Download it today!

468721.overview: Learn to curl! Play a competitive curling match against friends and family. Choose from 3 opponent difficulty levels or play online over Xbox LIVE. Compete for the most accurate shot in target competitions. Place stones anywhere on the ice and replay shots in practice mode. Earn awards and badges and track your curling statistics. A guided tutorial and overview of the rules of curling are included. Get sweeping!

468723.overview: Match 3 or more Pets to uncover the cute picture.

468724.overview:
Hey kids! Do you like failure? Are you suspicious of success? Do you smile at the thought of "accidental" electrocution? Then boy have we got the game for you!

Introducing Cute Things Dying Violently, a game where nothing bad happens. CTDV is all about hapless Critters, and the Critters need your help! Launch them around to get them safely out of each level. Dodge all sorts of lethal goodies like spikes, buzzsaws, and fire, and use a variety of wacky items to pull it off. And if a few dozen (or hundred) of them get turned into charred, smoking husks in your attempt to save them... something something omelettes and broken eggs. Broken, bloody eggs.

Featuring:
* 48 mind-bending, reflex-testing singleplayer levels * New Levels of the Week * 24 Achievements * Built-in Level Editor * Steam Workshop integration for sharing user-created levels and custom Critter designs * Free Android copy of the game included * A murderous, bucket-headed robot

468726.overview:
Test your skills as a space module pilot as you navigate the treacherous terrain of alien landscapes. Two modes allow you to hone your skills in basic play before showing off your abilities in advanced mode.

Coordination, finesse and nerves of steel are required to get top score. Do you have what it takes?

468729.overview:
Our hero Seamus can't fly, but he never touches the ground. Instead, he hangs by a rope and harness as he maneuvers his way through over 60 challenging puzzles!

In Cubicity, you pass across five worlds, in each world he'll need to acquire new weapons and learn new strategies in order to solve the increasingly difficult puzzles that block his path.

Part action/adventure, part puzzle/strategy, you'll need to be both smart and quick-fingered to reach the end. Are you up for the challenge?

468730.overview: As the newest intern on the job, keep up with the rapid flow of cubicle work to keep your job. Use intuitive thumbstick controls to master your daily routine. Player in single player mode, or compete head to head against a friend.

468732.overview: 1-4 players can play as Cyborg Mice in this fast paced arcade shooter. Blast training drones to earn money and buy new weapons, upgrades and maps in the store. Customize your mouse with unlockable fur colors, cybernetic implants and extra equipment. Enlist now in the Cyborg Mice Arena virtual training program!

468733.overview:
Cycloid is original arkanoid with realistic physics.

Explore 20 levels of dynamic environment, nice graphics and addictive gameplay.

468734.overview: Rotate the gems to form clusters of four or more within the time limit, then hit the targets to make it into the next round. Every few rounds the bar is raised. Two players can go head to head in an attempt to remove more gems then their opponent. Doing so will allow your avatar to attack. Knock out your adversary to win!

477865.overview:
A top down 360 shooter the uses all the power of the 360 modern controller.

How high can you get?

481424.overview:
In Crystal Quest, you can create a warrior, a magician or archer each with their own skills.

Find the crystal before time runs out. Defend it against hordes of monsters. Replay the game with a higher difficulty. Explore several different areas. Evolve different characters with upgrade stones. And more.

481446.overview:
In the middle of nowhere, someone has built a wonderful weapon, but now every type of stereotypical enemy wants it destroyed!

Beat back ninjas, zombies, robots and more with the cannon and its choice of four weapons! Fire, ice, lightning and vines. Each weapon has different effects on each enemy, so to stay alive, you will need to think on your feet.

481459.overview: Cell is a cellular life game, where your goal is to grow into the biggest cell. Using a clever mix of cautious thinking and twitch reflexes to eject your cells mass to propel you through each level, whilst carefully avoiding larger cells. Absorb your way through 45 levels that entertain and challenge you with gravity wells, intelligent cells and much more.

481461.overview: Conquest is a live action vehicle combat game with real time strategy elements. Your goal is to destroy your opponents base before they destroy yours. You can build defense turrets and construct AI controlled drones that you can command to help you accomplish this.

481516.overview: Chaos is a unique and addictive single- and multiplayer game. To advance in arcade mode slow down the surrounding antimatter particles with your forcefield until their trails disappear. In deathmatch, manipulate surrounding antimatter to destroy your opponents. Deathmatches are against human players or against an increasingly difficult roaster of AI-driven bots.
